name: emerald-code-studio
description: A fully open-source, local-first AI coding IDE. No subscriptions, no cloud lock-in, no limits.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
